title: Current SIP/RTP baseline and LDAP identity integration
summary: SIP v0.1-dev17 is the current signalling baseline; RTP v0.1-dev7 remains the shared media baseline. dev17 adds optional lazy SIP Digest credential provisioning from Identity Directory + Secret Broker while preserving independent call/media lifecycles.
invariants: SIP v0.1-dev17 is the current source baseline for this sphere.
SIP and RTP are separate components.
Outbound SIP client dialog control does not own RTP or audio worker lifecycle.
Twinkle REGISTER/OPTIONS behavior remains a regression boundary.
Known estate dependency heads must not be confused with source bytes actually used for a build.
LDAP Identity v0.1-dev22 may supply SIP Digest principal/credential metadata through the optional adapter; SIP remains Digest protocol authority.
